facts.fact: A presidential decree on the secure digital interoperability plan, to frame the interconnection between institutions and administrations, is reported as being drawn up on the president's instruction at the latest Council of Ministers; it is a draft presidential decree, and the article gives no date for the Council, so the article's publication date is used.
facts.system: Presidential decree on the digital interoperability plan (draft)

facts.fact: Presidential decree no. 25-320 of 30 December 2025, published in the Journal Officiel no. 87, sets up a national data governance system whose national interoperability system secures data exchange between public institutions and administrations (Art. 1, 2, 5, 9).

Presidential decree no. 25-320 of 30 December 2025 makes the national interoperability system the exclusive framework for exchanging digital data between public institutions and administrations over the secure national interconnection network (Art. 10), and requires each body to classify and catalogue its data to gain access (Art. 12).
